mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at 1.58% represents a historically low level, signaling an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.0%, it signals economic distress and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to declining corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL signal monetary tightening and inflation, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction of rising FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL produces negative returns in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (defined by GDP growth > 3.0% annualized), overvaluation and policy tightening expectations cause negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to profit-taking and risk-off sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized).

mechanism_narrative: A high employment level (PAYEMS > 150,000) indicates strong labor market conditions, driving consumer spending and business confidence, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to declining earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous falling HOUST and RSAFS indicate a contracting housing market, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to reduced economic confidence.
failure_condition: The interaction of falling HOUST and falling RSAFS produces negative returns in less than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, increasing market volatility and risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances during high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY).
